verdict.rationale: Sprinto publishes an API reference section in its docs, covering Custom Integration Push APIs with integration monitoring and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs. It also documents inbound webhooks that let external systems push data in. However, the documented surface is narrow (pushing integration data and reading health/vendor data), and probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path. missing for 10: evidence the API can drive core workflows (tasks, controls, policies, risks, audits), authentication/endpoint detail, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
